C1.note: Public docs do not expose the internal provider block representation.

C2.note: Chats retain their own context and results.

C3.note: A checked-out repository and container file system externalize working state.

C4.note: Codex supports manual and automatic chat compaction.

D1.note: Cloud work is delegated to an isolated hosted environment.

D2.note: The agent runs remotely in a configured container.

D3.note: Goals and chats can be paused, resumed, and steered.

P1.note: Plan mode and execution-plan guidance are documented.

P2.note: Goal mode treats the goal as completion criteria and asks for verification.

P3.note: The cloud loop edits, runs checks, and tries to validate work.

P4.note: Testing and review loops expose failures, but internal error-context semantics are not public.

P5.note: No public per-tool circuit-breaker contract found.

M1.note: Same-chat context persists through long work.

M2.note: Cloud containers provide a repository workspace.

S1.note: Independent subagent work can run in parallel.

S2.note: Subagents have separate threads and return summaries.

G1.note: Sandbox and approval policy constrain actions.

G2.note: Goals pause for decisions without broadening authorization.

G3.note: Each cloud chat runs in an isolated environment.

X1.note: Commands, answers, and diffs are inspectable.

X2.note: Goal progress and steering are surfaced.

X3.note: Running goals can be paused and resumed.

X4.note: Session status and token-consuming subagents are visible; full cost telemetry varies by surface.

X5.note: Completion includes an answer, diff, and PR/follow-up handoff.
